messages.author: Arthur Glasfeld
messages.body:
Sorry for starting my interactions with the Amber community with an installation issue.
I’m installing Amber20 (and AmberTools20) on a Mac running OS 10.13.6 and was following the installation instructions here: http://ambermd.org/InstMacOS.php
When run_cmake concluded, it instructed me to type “make install”, which I did from ~/amber20_src/build.  It went well initially until I the set of notifications listed below.
The command “./b2” fails (no file named b2 in build) and I couldn’t find the path described:
Build engine with toolset darwin... tools/build/src/engine/bin.macosxx86_64/b2
And I couldn’t find the file, project-config.jam.
Unfortunately, my online reading and use of the manual hasn’t given me insight.  Thanks to anyone who can set me straight.
Arthur Glasfeld
Reed College
Portland, OR USA

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, May 13, 2020, Arthur Glasfeld wrote:
>
>The command “./b2” fails
>/bin/sh: cmake: command not found
Here is the problem: cmake is not in your PATH.  We need to update the
installation instructions to make this clear.  If you downloaded cmake
for kitware, the try something like this:
export PATH=/Applications/CMake.app/Contents/bin:$PATH
Change the first part if your cmake came from some other source.
...good luck....dac
